answer: An AI agent economy resists Sybil attacks by enforcing computational staking and memory-bound proofs, treating identity validation like a dense dune resisting wind erosion. Each legitimate agent must lock cryptographic tokens against a ferrous core of verifiable hardware execution traces, creating an immutable mirror of its operational history. To flood the network with fake nodes, an attacker must incur prohibitive capital expenditures for physical silicon and continuous energy consumption, making unauthorized replication economically unviable.
